question: The Farakka barrage is situated on ______ river.
solution: The correct answer is __**Ganga**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Farakka Barrage** is constructed on the **Ganga River**, one of the most important rivers in **India**. It is situated in the **Murshidabad district** of **West Bengal**. • The primary purpose of the Farakka Barrage is to **divert water** from the Ganga into the **Bhagirathi-Hooghly River system** to ensure the navigability of the Kolkata Port. • The barrage was **commissioned in 1975** and is a crucial infrastructure for **water resource management** in the region. • It spans a length of **2,240 meters**, making it one of the largest barrages in the world. • The Farakka Barrage also plays a significant role in **irrigation**, **flood control**, and **hydropower generation**, benefiting millions of people in **West Bengal and Bihar**.
